Match Overview

The match between Saint-Étienne and Nice will take place on May 26, 2026, at the Stade Geoffroy-Guichard. This fixture is part of the Ligue 1 competition during the 2025-2026 season, and both teams are eager to secure vital points as the season draws to a close.

Why This Match Matters

Saint-Étienne is currently fighting to avoid relegation, sitting two points above the drop zone. Nice, on the other hand, is contending for a European qualification spot, six points shy of the last Europa League position. A win is crucial for both teams to achieve their respective goals in this final stretch of the season.
